strings.Tu comprador europeo ya está pidiendo la: Your coffee and cocoa from Peru now needs proof. Origen produces it at origin: plot-by-plot geolocation, checks against 4 satellite sources, and a dossier + GeoJSON ready for your due diligence statement in TRACES. Dozens of plots from many farmers and regions become one dossier per shipment — captured by your suppliers on their phones, in minutes.
strings.Desde el 30 de diciembre de 2026, toda c: From 30 December 2026, every operator placing coffee or cocoa on the EU market must show — plot by plot — that it was not grown on land deforested after 2020. Without that data you cannot file your due diligence statement, and it can only come from origin.
strings.Las soluciones son carísimas: Most tools stop at the importer
strings.Hechas para grandes importadores. Y, com: They are built for large importers. As Fairtrade has warned, the cost of compliance ends up with smallholder farmers who already live on the edge — and the plot data never arrives.
strings.Mapear parcelas se está volviendo gratis: Mapping plots is becoming free. What you need is verified evidence you can actually file.
strings.30 dic 2026 para operadores grandes y me: 30 Dec 2026 for large and medium operators; 30 Jun 2027 for micro and small ones. Europe buys about half of Peru's cocoa and almost half of its coffee.
From plot to dossier in three steps.
strings.Sin planillas, sin consultoras caras. El: No spreadsheets, no costly consultants. Your supplier's technician captures the plots in the field and Origen assembles the package your statement needs.
strings.El técnico registra cada parcela con el: The technician records each plot with the phone's GPS and a photo; on plots over 4 ha they walk the boundary to capture the polygon the EUDR requires. Works without signal.
strings.Cruzamos cada parcela con cuatro fuentes: Each plot is checked against four official sources — Hansen, recent alerts, protected areas (WDPA) and the EU's JRC 2020 reference map — and marked clean, review or deforestation.
strings.Generamos el dossier y el GeoJSON listos: You receive the dossier and the TRACES-ready GeoJSON — per lot, or with dozens of plots consolidated into one dossier per shipment.
strings.Sin pérdida de bosque tras el 31-dic-202: No forest loss after 31 Dec 2020. Ready for the dossier.
strings.Señal dudosa cerca del límite. La verifi: Doubtful signal near the boundary. Checked before the lot ships.
strings.Pérdida de bosque detectada. Se marca pa: Forest loss detected. Flagged to exclude or substantiate.
strings.Tu comprador no acopia de una sola parce: A container rarely comes from a single plot: it pools coffee from dozens of farmers and several regions. The EUDR requires the geolocation of every plot behind each shipment. What consultants charge thousands to assemble, Origen generates in one click.
strings.Marca los lotes de un contenedor —de muc: Select the lots in a container — from many farmers and regions — and get a single dossier + TRACES-ready GeoJSON.
strings.Si una sola parcela está observada, el e: If a single plot is flagged, the whole shipment is flagged and you see exactly which plot to exclude or substantiate. The EUDR does not allow offsetting: Origen keeps it clean.
strings.Cruzamos los kilos declarados con el ren: Declared kilos are checked against the realistic yield of the area. If they don't add up, we flag it before EU customs does.

strings.Aplazamiento del EUDR: fechas vigentes y: EUDR delay: current deadlines and latest news
strings.No hay un nuevo aplazamiento. El reglame: There is no new delay. The EU Deforestation Regulation applies from 30 December 2026 to large and medium-sized companies, and from 30 June 2027 to micro and small ones.
strings.Empresas grandes y medianas, y micro y p: Large and medium-sized companies, plus micro and small ones already covered by the EU Timber Regulation.
strings.Productos que se suman: café soluble, al: Newly added products: soluble coffee, certain palm oil derivatives and frozen cattle tongues.
strings.La fecha de corte no cambió: la tierra d: The cut-off date has not changed: the land the product comes from must not have been deforested after 31 December 2020.
strings.A la fecha de esta actualización, no hay: As of this update, there is no proposal to delay it again.
strings.En su revisión del 4 de mayo de 2026, la: In its review of 4 May 2026, the European Commission kept the dates and concluded that it is not appropriate to propose further amendments to the text of the regulation, to give companies legal certainty. It chose to simplify in other ways: new guidance and FAQs, improvements to the information system and two public repositories, one with the relevant laws of each producing country and one with certification schemes, which it plans to launch before December 2026.
strings.La única propuesta en trámite es de sept: The only proposal in progress dates from September 2026: taking French Guiana out of the regulation's scope. It changes nothing for coffee or cocoa imported from Peru. The next general review is due by 30 June 2030.
strings.Entra en vigor el Reglamento (UE) 2023/1: Regulation (EU) 2023/1115 enters into force. It was due to apply from 30 December 2024.
strings.Primer aplazamiento, con el Reglamento (: First delay, through Regulation (EU) 2024/3234: one more year, to 30 December 2025, and to 30 June 2026 for micro and small companies.
strings.La Comisión clasifica a los países por r: The Commission classifies countries by risk. Peru is classified as standard risk; only four countries are high risk.
strings.Segundo aplazamiento y simplificación, c: Second delay and simplification, through Regulation (EU) 2025/2650: 30 December 2026 and 30 June 2027.
strings.Revisión de simplificación de la Comisió: Commission simplification review: it keeps the dates, proposes no change to the regulation and announces improvements to the information system (TRACES).
strings.La Comisión adopta la nueva lista de pro: The Commission adopts the new product list and the new rules for the information system.
strings.Propuesta para excluir a la Guayana Fran: Proposal to exclude French Guiana from the regulation, pending before the Council.
strings.Entra en vigor el Reglamento Delegado (U: Delegated Regulation (EU) 2026/2102 enters into force, with the new product list.
strings.Se aplican las nuevas reglas del sistema: The new information system rules apply (Implementing Regulation (EU) 2026/1565).
strings.Empieza a aplicarse a las empresas grand: Starts to apply to large and medium-sized companies.
strings.Empieza a aplicarse a las micro y pequeñ: Starts to apply to micro and small companies.
strings.Se exigen los productos que se suman, co: The newly added products, such as soluble coffee, become mandatory.
Next general review of the regulation.
Gold dots mark what is coming.
strings.solo presenta la declaración de diligenc: only the operator who first places the product on the EU market submits the due diligence statement. Those who buy and resell it afterwards no longer submit one; if they are not SMEs, they register in the system, and the first of them keeps the statement's reference number.
strings.los micro y pequeños productores primari: micro and small primary operators in low-risk countries submit a simplified declaration, just once.
strings.desde el 18 de septiembre de 2026 salen: since 18 September 2026, leather, most retreaded tyres and some rubber articles and vehicle seats are out. Soluble coffee, certain palm oil derivatives such as soaps, and frozen cattle tongues are in, and become mandatory from 30 December 2027.
strings.la Comisión calcula que estas medidas ba: the Commission estimates that these measures cut the annual cost of compliance by around 75%, from EUR 8.1 billion to EUR 2.0 billion.
strings.Qué significa para el café y el cacao de: What it means for coffee and cocoa from Peru
strings.El Perú es país de riesgo estándar. El i: Peru is a standard-risk country. As the operator, you carry out full due diligence and need the geolocation of every plot; the simplified declaration does not apply to Peruvian producers.
strings.El café y el cacao que entren a Europa d: Coffee and cocoa entering the EU from 30 December 2026 must already comply, and those purchases are being negotiated now. That is why buyers are already asking their suppliers for the data.
strings.Registra cada parcela: un punto GPS hast: Ask your Peruvian suppliers for every plot: a GPS point up to 4 hectares and the full polygon if it is larger.
strings.Comprueba que ninguna parcela se haya de: Check that no plot has been deforested after 31 December 2020.
strings.Arma por cada envío el paquete de datos: Collect one data package per shipment, with the GeoJSON, for your due diligence statement in TRACES.
